description: This file defines an Android activity class `OrdersActivity` that manages displaying and filtering a list of orders in a shopping platform. It handles user interface setup, filter controls, data collection via ViewModel, and UI state updates.

classes.name: OrdersActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a list of orders with filtering, refresh, and pagination features.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, adapters, data collection, and event handlers.

methods.name: setupRecyclerAnimations
methods.description: Configures RecyclerView item animator for visual effects.

methods.name: setupFilterControls
methods.description: Sets up filter UI controls such as status chips, email input, and date pickers with corresponding event listeners.

methods.name: syncControlsToState
methods.description: Synchronizes UI filter controls to reflect current filter state.

methods.name: setDateButtonLabels
methods.description: Updates the labels of date filter buttons based on selected date values.

methods.name: updateEmptyStateText
methods.description: Updates the empty view message based on current filter state.

methods.name: renderActiveFilterChips
methods.description: Displays active filter indicators as removable chips.

methods.name: statusLabelForChip
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly label for a given order status.

methods.name: showDatePicker
methods.description: Displays a date picker dialog and executes a callback with the selected date.
